```{webr}
#| include: false
#| autorun: true
# Site-wide webR session defaults. This hidden cell runs automatically on page
# load (autorun) and renders nothing (include: false). It is pulled in via an
# include shortcode on every page with interactive cells, right after the
# quarto-live _knitr.qmd include. (Do not write the include shortcode literally
# in this file - Quarto expands include shortcodes even inside code blocks,
# which makes this file include itself recursively.)
options(
  readr.show_col_types = FALSE,   # quiet read_csv() column-spec message
  dplyr.summarise.inform = FALSE  # quiet summarise() grouping message
)
```
